title: Manifest
description: The manifest of a plugin (HP MN-1).

$schema.description: An editor hint that is accepted and ignored (HP A2-43).

botster_plugin_api.description: The plugin API major version the plugin targets (HP section 18). The value is `1`.

source.description: Informational only: the source recorded at install is the truth (HP PD-1, PM-1).

views.description: View documents of the UI contract (HP VW-1, VW-6).

limits.description: Optional requests for `PluginLimits`, bounded by the Hub parameters (HP MN-1). The keys are limit names.

PluginName.description: HP PD-1: lowercase letters, digits and `-`; no `@`, no `__`.

RequiredFeatures.description: The two feature sets of `requirements.features` (HP PD-2).

InterfaceExport.description: One exported tool of a provided interface (HP PD-3). `effect` is compared for equality (PD-3b).

Requires.description: `requires: [{interface, range, optional?}]` (HP PD-5). `range` is a semver range over the `interface_version`.

ServiceEntry.description: The Lua entry (HP MN-1, A2-47): a path relative to the package root.

Capability.description: A manifest capability (HP MN-1, MN-2, NT-2, CP-8). Also the entry of `Ready.grants`. `allow` is only on surface `net` (HP MN-1): the decoder and the schema refuse it elsewhere.

optional.description: Only on a capability the plugin can do without (HP CP-8, MN-1).

SessionTypeDecl.description: A session type in the manifest (HP MN-1, CA-13). The contract states only the fields below; other keys are accepted.

Interaction.description: `interaction` of a session or a session type (HC section 6, HP CA-18).

Presentation.description: `presentation` of a session or a session type (HC section 6, HP CA-18).

NotificationMode.description: The mode of a terminal-notification policy (HP CA-22).

ConfigDecl.description: A configuration entry (HP MN-1, CF-1). The contract names the `type` key without its values, so it is a string.

SecretDecl.description: A secret the plugin declares (HP MN-1, NT-5).

FsRootDecl.description: A filesystem root (HP MN-1, FS-1). `read` is always `true`; there is no write in v1.

StaticRoute.description: A static route (HP MN-1, WP-5, A2-46). `root` may be `package:<relative dir>`.

AssetContentType.description: The allowed `content_type` values of `assets.publish` and of staged assets (HP A2-19). Any other value is `invalid_request{content_type_not_allowed}`.

McpServerDecl.description: A declared MCP server (HP MN-1, MP-1). A `stdio` entry needs `command`; an `http` entry needs `url`; any other combination fails the load `manifest_bad_mcp_server`.

McpRestart.description: The restart policy of a declared MCP server (HP MP-8): `{max, window}` with `window` in milliseconds (WF-5).

CollectionDecl.description: A store collection (HP ST-1, ST-11). `schema_version` is the version written and `accepts` the versions read; the contract does not fix their JSON type.

IndexDecl.description: A named, ordered index (HP ST-1). Every collection also has the implicit `id` index.

IndexFieldType.description: The declared scalar type of an index field (HP ST-1).

EventsDecl.description: The events section of `Ready` and of the manifest (HP HS-2, MN-3, EV-15).

gap_handler.description: The handler id of the `event_gap` handler (HP EV-15).

DeclaredEvent.description: An event a plugin declares that it emits (HP EV-1, MN-3, Appendix B). `priority` is a name of `Hello.priorities` (default `normal`).

keyed.description: The event may carry a coalescing `key` (HP EV-13, MN-3). Present in the manifest entry.

StateSource.description: The `state_source` of an event declaration (HP EV-1, EV-12, MN-3).

EventPattern.description: The `{owner, name}` pattern of a subscription (HP EV-2).

SubjectsScope.description: Which sessions a subscription covers (HP EV-2, CP-4).

EntityFamilyDecl.description:
A declared entity family (HP EN-1). `kind` is the family name in the plugin's own namespace, `schema_version` is `M.m`.
EN-1 names `actions` ("argument and result schemas and required permissions") without field names, so each action is an open object.
Other keys are accepted: the contract states no more fields here.

ViewDocument.description: The view document (section 2 of ui-contract 1.0; `placement` is UI-PL-1).

Part.description: The data and structural parts (UI-PT-1; `embed` is UI-EM-1, behind the feature `ui_embed`).

Source.description: A source of rows of one kind (UI-BD-2).

Operand.description: An operand (UI-BD-1, UI-BD-3). Each variant is written as an object with one key.

oneOf.description: A field of the bound row.
The row that an action or item sits on.
The current value of a form field (`/<property name>`).
`"<selection id><Path>"`, the selected row of a slot.
`"<ref id><Path>"`, a field of a resolved ref.

Ref.description: A typed reference to a row of another kind (UI-RF-1 to UI-RF-4).

AbsentCopy.description: What a ref shows when it has no target (UI-RF-2).

OrUnknown.description:
A value that is one of the known variants, or a name that this release does not know.
UI-VR-2 says a client ignores an unknown optional `tone`, `display` or `widget` and counts it.

Tone.description: Clause: UI-CF-4. A tone maps to a style, never to a fixed color.

Activate.description: An activation (UI-SL-3; `navigate` and `url` are UI-SL-5 and UI-SL-7 of ui-contract 1.1).

Navigate.description: The target of a navigation (UI-SL-5, UI-AC-6, UI-SL-6): a view of the same package and preset slots.

Field.description: A field (the one definition of section 5 of ui-contract 1.0).

OrUnknown2.description:
A value that is one of the known variants, or a name that this release does not know.
UI-VR-2 says a client ignores an unknown optional `tone`, `display` or `widget` and counts it.

MapEntry.description: One entry of a `Field.map` (section 5 of ui-contract 1.0, UI-FD-2).

Action.description: An action (section 9 of ui-contract 1.0; `disabled_reason` is UI-AC-8, `warning` is UI-SA-5).

CopyText.description: Copy for a state (UI-CP-1 to UI-CP-4).

Column.description: A table column (section 3 of ui-contract 1.0): a field with `label`, and `path` or `ref`.

DetailSource.description: The source of a `detail`: one row by id, or the selected row of a slot (UI-PT-5, UI-SL-2).

OperandOrLit.description: A literal JSON value or an operand (`text.value`, `detail.source.id`, UI-PT-5).

action.description: The id of the action that this form submits.

FromPage.description: One message that a page may send (UI-EM-5, UI-EM-14): `invoke` or `select`.

ToPage.description: One push of rows to a page (UI-EM-5, UI-EM-14).

EmbedPart.description: UI-EM-1 (ui-contract 1.2). A document that uses it sets `requires: ["ui_embed"]`.

NoticeReaction.description: A notice reaction (HP VW-9, MN-1). The pointers are JSON pointers into the event payload.

SubjectScope.description: The `subject_scope` of a notice reaction (HP VW-9). Default `own`.

Severity.description: The severity of a notice (HP VW-9).

PackageScope.description: The package scope (HP CP-8, MN-1). Default `device`.

SessionActionUi.description: An action that a plugin contributes to Hub session rows (HP VW-8).

ActionEffect.description: The client effect classes of DS-1 (HP VW-8).

AppliesTo.description: The closed equality filter of a contributed session action (HP VW-8). Any other field fails the load `manifest_bad_applies_to`.

OneOrMany.description: One value of an `applies_to` term: a string or a list of strings (any of).
